Usage: resecta-data build calibrate [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  Phase 3b calibration artifacts produced from Swift-side dumps.

Options:
  --help  Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  finalize     Promote a reviewed sweep_raw artifact to the shipping preset file.
  sweep        Sweep per-category thresholds against a Swift score dump.
  temperature  Fit the scalar doctype-softmax temperature T against a Swift dump.
